messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take spironolactone exactly as prescribed.
Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides.
Take spironolactone the same way each day, either always with food or always without.
Food increases how much spironolactone your body absorbs.
This roughly doubles spironolactone absorption.
Switching back and forth changes how much medicine you actually get.
Shake the oral liquid well before every dose.
Measure oral liquid with the marked oral syringe, dosing spoon, or medicine cup that comes with oral liquid.
Do not use a kitchen spoon.
Do not switch between tablets and the oral liquid without your doctor changing the dose.
They are not interchangeable.
The liquid gives a higher level of medicine in your blood for the same number of milligrams.
You will need regular blood tests to check your potassium, sodium, kidney function, uric acid, and blood sugar.
Keep these appointments even if you feel completely well.
If you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep taking spironolactone even when you feel fine.
High blood pressure usually has no symptoms.
Triplet: ["high blood pressure", "has characteristic", "usually no symptoms"]

The relation 'has characteristic' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or entity is characterized by the feature or property specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
C. 'occurs if': The condition or event specified by the subject entity happens under the condition described in the object entity.
D. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
